notes: All 26 winners taken from the Fox News New York results page, which shows an AP call time for every district (latest: NY-21 on Nov 6). Close races: NY-1 LaLota 51.1-48.9 (AP call Nov 5; Gallant conceded), NY-2 Garbarino (AP call Nov 5; NBC New York called it neck-and-neck on election night), NY-17 Conley over Lawler (Lawler conceded election night; AP call Nov 5), NY-21 Constantino about 50.9-48.8 over Gendebien (AP call Nov 6; Gendebien conceded Nov 6 per political.org). Cross-checks: amNY lists NY-3,5-15 winners matching Fox; NBC New York projected Gillen (NY-4); WAMC/Spectrum/Ballotpedia News/WIVB/WXXI/CNY Central confirm Riley, Ryan, Tonko, Mannion, Langworthy, Tenney, Morelle, Kennedy; Yahoo/NBC confirm Latimer. The NYS Focus results interactive still showed all 26 races as uncalled with no vote data as of Nov 13; that looks like a data-feed gap rather than a disagreement. Results are unofficial until state certification. Backgrounds/previous for new winners come from the source_url of each row plus WAMC (Stefanik retirement, Dec 19 2025); the winner itself is from the Fox News/AP page. NY-7 winner Valdez is described by amNY as a Queens Assembly member. Background/previous sources: NY-7,10,12,13 amNY primary results https://www.amny.com/news/primary-results-democrats-house-comptroller-2026/ ; NY-17 https://www.fox5ny.com/news/ny-cait-conley-mike-lawler-profile-midterms-election-politics ; NY-21 https://www.cityandstateny.com/politics/2026/11/constantino-declares-victory-ny-21-gendebien-not-conceding/417028/ and https://www.wamc.org/2025-12-19/rep-elise-stefanik-ends-her-campaign-for-new-york-governor-and-wont-seek-reelection-to-house
